calculations_vs_stored.notes: Downstream systems MUST NOT recompute pricing other than the verification calculations defined here.

actions.name: create_snapshot
actions.notes: Computes totals and signature_hash atomically; status begins as 'created'. In v3.0.9+, snapshot MUST record event/occurrence scope and pricing program revision traceability.

actions.name: activate_snapshot
actions.notes: Transition created->active only; idempotent when already active.

actions.name: consume_snapshot
actions.notes: Transition active->consumed only; MUST fail if consumed_by_order_id already set to different order.

resources.immutability_posture: Pricing fields + signature_hash immutable after create_snapshot; only lifecycle fields change per state_machine rules.

actions.name: create_line
actions.notes: Lines are created only within create_snapshot; no standalone API exposure.

actions.name: archive_program
actions.notes: Archives program. MUST NOT archive if active orders depend on future quotes; policy enforced upstream.

actions.name: activate_revision
actions.notes: Activates draft. MUST retire prior active revision atomically.

actions.name: retire_revision
actions.notes: Retires an active revision (rare; usually superseded).

actions.name: create_phase
actions.notes: Creates phase under a draft revision.

actions.name: create_rule
actions.notes: Creates rule under a draft revision.

tenancy.notes: All pricing snapshots and lines are tenant-scoped; no platform-scoped pricing.

change_log: 3.0.8: Lockability + determinism fixes (totals, signature canon, ERR registry discipline, dependency graph)
3.0.9: Add versioned pricing programs (revisions, phases, rules) + occurrence-aware snapshot scope + PRICE-SIG-V2 with backward verification support.

changes: Introduce PRICE-SIG-V3 (incl. entitlement context) for tamper-resistant pricing across phases and subscriber offers.
Add SUB-1 as a hard dependency for entitlement-aware pricing policies.
Fix PRICE-SIG-V3 canonical_encoding record prefix (remove stale PRICE-SIG-V2 prefix).
Update documentation text to make PRICE-SIG-V3 the active canonicalization version while retaining verification support for V1+V2.
Bump ERR-1 dependency to >=1.3.30.
Update test-gate artifact references and add explicit assertions for PRICE-SIG-V3 invariants.
Bump OBS-1 dependency to >=2.7.7 (SUB-1 integration finalized in OBS).
Align PRICE-SIG-V3 signature test-gate expectation with the actual V3 entitlement-binding line fields (beneficiary_customer_id, entitlement_grant_id, entitlement_tier_id).
No change to the PRICE-SIG-V3 canonical record layout; this patch corrects CI enforcement.
Add tax_context_digest_sha256 as required snapshot field and include it in signature payload (PRICE-SIG-V4).
Add invariant PRICE-INV-SIG-BIND-002 to prevent tax audit drift and replay/substitution across contexts.
Align dependency floors with patched suite (TEN-1 1.7.4, ERR-1 1.4.9, OBS-1 2.7.6).
change_log.summary: Introduce PRICE-SIG-V4 to bind tax context into signed pricing snapshots.
Unify canonical signature to PRICE-SIG-V4; add explicit tax_pricing_mode bound by signature; clarify tax-context requirements for add-on tax markets.

changes: Introduce quote_id, quote_issued_at_utc, quote_expires_at_utc and total_minor/internal_rounding_adjustment_minor outputs on PricingSnapshot.
Define FeeLine resource with is_taxable, tax_category, customer_visible, revenue_owner and include it in signature payload.
Switch signature_spec canonical_encoding to RFC8785_JCS and normalize PRICE-SIG-V4 record layout/version tags.
Align arithmetic invariants to include internal_rounding_adjustment_minor and total_minor; define net subtotal (after discounts) and keep gross_subtotal for audit.
change_log.summary: Adopt RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical signature physics; add quote TTL fields, fee line declarations (taxable/visibility/revenue_owner), and rounding adjustment outputs required by ND-180..ND-188.

notes: Producer MUST resolve registry_version_sha from V42_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_SHA at runtime (not hardcoded).
No business payload schema changes; envelope header carries registry_version_sha.
change_log.summary: Wiring-only: add runtime Registry SHA binding invariant and raise EVT-1 dependency floor to 2.14.0 (cryptographic fence).

changes: PricingSnapshot.signature_hash notes/type aligned to PRICE-SIG-V4 sha256 over RFC8785 JCS byte stream.
FeeLine.revenue_owner expanded to include payment_processor/government/third_party; ownership must be explicit.
FeeLine.tax_total_minor defined as single-truth for fee tax attribution; forbid silent folding.
Added P0 invariants and gates to prevent regression and legacy algorithm references.
change_log.summary: Semantic hardening: align signature_hash to PRICE-SIG-V4 sha256/JCS; lock tax mode mapping to TAX-1; expand fee revenue ownership; require fee tax single-truth.

ord_validates: pricing_snapshot.status MUST be 'active' at verification time
pricing_snapshot totals MUST match recomputed totals from signed line fields (see invariants.arithmetic_truth)
pricing_snapshot MUST NOT be consumed by a different order (consumed_by_order_id MUST be null OR equal this order_id)
all lines MUST be same currency as snapshot (mixed currency forbidden)
all line arithmetic invariants MUST hold (line_total_minor truth)
pricing_snapshot.signature_version MUST be supported by the verifier (PRICE-SIG-V4 only)..
pricing_snapshot.signature_hash MUST match recomputed signature over stored snapshot+lines using pricing_snapshot.signature_version's input model.

dependencies.reason: Subscriber entitlements used for subscriber/VIP pricing context.
Event registry head pin (Phase-5 Airlock floor parity).
Event envelope schema_ref for outbox_events emitted by PRICE-1.
Atomic monotonic pricing version increment requires session-affine advisory locks (Namespace 102).

downstream_consumers.notes: Non-normative: ORD consumes PricingSnapshot for checkout verification and MUST NOT cause PRICE contract dependency edges.

PRICE-1-INV-LOCK-NAMESPACE-102-001.text: Any producer that emits ticketing.pricing.snapshot.generated.v1 MUST take a LOCKS-1 advisory lock with Namespace 102 on (org_id,event_id) before advancing PricingEventCursor.
PRICE-1-INV-LOCK-NAMESPACE-102-001.why: Prevents concurrent version assignment under high concurrency.

PRICE-1-INV-MONOTONIC-VERSION-001.text: Producer MUST implement atomic increment semantics for PricingSnapshot.version using PricingEventCursor and LOCKS-1 Namespace 102. Version MUST be > 0 and unique per (org_id,event_id).
PRICE-1-INV-MONOTONIC-VERSION-001.why: Enables deterministic ordering and gap detection for pricing evolution; prevents replay/race corruption during hot sales.

invariants.PRICE-1-INV-REGISTRY-BINDING-001: Producer MUST NOT hardcode the registry_version_sha. Producer MUST resolve registry_version_sha at runtime from the V42_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_SHA environment configuration. If missing or malformed (NOT matching ^[0-9a-f]{64}$), producer MUST refuse to emit events (fail fast). LEGACY_SHA_SENTINEL (64 zeros) MAY ONLY be used in explicit backfill/migration mode.

PRICE-INV-FEE-TAX-SINGLE-TRUTH-001.text: FeeLine.tax_total_minor is the single source of truth for tax attributable to each fee line. Services MUST NOT omit fee tax attribution or represent it only in PriceLine.tax_total_minor without a matching FeeLine.tax_total_minor.

invariants.PRICE-INV-NONSTACK-001: If entitlement_grant_id or entitlement_tier_id is present on a PriceLine (subscriber-priced line), then discount_stack_kind MUST equal "none" and discount_total_minor MUST equal 0. Violations MUST raise subcode PRICE_DISCOUNT_STACK_FORBIDDEN.
invariants.PRICE-INV-QUOTE-ALIAS-001: quote_id MUST equal snapshot_id (alias) for this contract version family to preserve backward compatibility while enabling ND-182 field names.
invariants.PRICE-INV-QUOTE-ALIAS-002: quote_issued_at_utc MUST equal created_at_utc (DB-monotonic issuance time).
invariants.PRICE-INV-QUOTE-TTL-001: quote_expires_at_utc - quote_issued_at_utc MUST be bounded by environment profile: HOT_SALE <= 15 minutes, NORMAL <= 60 minutes (ND-183).
invariants.PRICE-INV-QUOTE-TTL-002: For backward compatibility, expires_at_utc MUST equal quote_expires_at_utc.
invariants.PRICE-INV-SIG-BIND-001: PRICE-SIG-V4 canonical signature payload MUST include discount_stack_kind when present (see signature_spec.input_model.line_fields_in_order). This prevents discount context from being introduced after signing.
invariants.PRICE-INV-SIG-BIND-002: PRICE-SIG-V4 canonical signature payload MUST include tax_context_digest_sha256 AND quote_expires_at_utc. This prevents replay/substitution of a signed snapshot across tax contexts or after TTL expiry.
invariants.PRICE-INV-SIG-BIND-003: PRICE-SIG-V4 canonical signature payload MUST include FeeLine.{is_taxable,tax_category,customer_visible,revenue_owner} for every fee line. Missing declarations are forbidden and MUST fail-closed.

PRICE-INV-SIG-HASH-ALGO-LOCK-001.text: PricingSnapshot.signature_hash MUST be computed as sha256 hex lowercase digest per PRICE-SIG-V4, consistent with /signature_spec.algorithm=sha256 and /signature_spec.canonical_encoding.standard=RFC8785_JCS. Any reference to legacy algorithms (e.g., BLAKE3) for signature_hash is forbidden.

PRICE-INV-SIG-VERIFY-001.rationale: Prevents client-side or mid-stream mutation of fee/tax/rounding fields and blocks replay of altered quotes.
PRICE-INV-SIG-VERIFY-001.text: Any component that persists or consumes a PricingSnapshot MUST recompute the canonical JSON representation per signature_spec (RFC8785) and verify that (signature_version, signature_hash) matches the computed value. If verification fails, the snapshot MUST be rejected and treated as tampered or drifted. Canonicalization follows RFC 8785 (JCS).
PRICE-INV-SIG-VERIFY-001.title: PricingSnapshot signatures MUST be verifiable from canonical JSON

must: PricingSnapshot.tax_pricing_mode MUST be present and MUST be one of {inclusive, exclusive_add_on}.
PricingSnapshot.tax_pricing_mode MUST be included in the PRICE-SIG-V4 canonical record and MUST be signature-bound.

If tax_pricing_mode = exclusive_add_on, the pricing engine MUST have sufficient jurisdiction context to compute tax_total_minor; otherwise PricingSnapshot creation MUST fail with ERR-1 subcode TAX_JURISDICTION_REQUIRED (or TAX_PROFILE_REQUIRED where applicable).
tax_context_digest_sha256 MUST be computed from a canonical tax context that includes tax_pricing_mode and the jurisdiction inputs used to compute tax_total_minor.
notes: Default posture is inclusive pricing to avoid surprise checkout totals, but explicit add-on markets are supported via tax_pricing_mode.

PRICE-INV-TAX-MODE-MAPPING-001.text: PRICE-1 tax_pricing_mode MUST map to TAX-1 inclusion_mode deterministically: tax_pricing_mode=inclusive ↔ inclusion_mode=inclusive; tax_pricing_mode=exclusive_add_on ↔ inclusion_mode=exclusive. This mapping MUST be treated as part of the signed pricing snapshot semantics (PRICE-SIG-V4) and MUST NOT be inferred ad hoc.

arithmetic_truth.line_total_formula: line_total_minor MUST equal (quantity*unit_price_minor) - discount_total_minor + fee_total_minor + tax_total_minor

snapshot_totals_formula.tax_total_minor: SUM(PriceLine.tax_total_minor) over PriceLine + SUM(FeeLine.tax_total_minor) over FeeLine (if fee tax is modeled separately, it MUST be included in tax_total_minor)

auditability.consumption_linkage: When consumed, consumed_by_order_id MUST be set exactly once and MUST NOT change thereafter.
auditability.one_to_one_consumption: At most one order MAY consume a given snapshot (enforce by immutable consumed_by_order_id).

currency_rules.snapshot_currency_format: currency MUST match regex ^[A-Z]{3}$ (ISO-4217 uppercase form)

idempotency.create_snapshot_key: idempotency_key is REQUIRED input to create_snapshot and stored on PricingSnapshot

mismatch_behavior.note: Inputs differ for an existing idempotency_key

idempotency.replay_behavior: If the same (org_id, idempotency_key) is reused with identical canonical pricing inputs, the service MUST return the existing snapshot_id
idempotency.uniqueness: Uniqueness MUST be enforced on (org_id, idempotency_key)

immutability.consumed_terminal: status='consumed' is terminal; no further transitions or modifications allowed.
immutability.price_lines_immutable: PriceLine records MUST NOT be updated or deleted after creation.
immutability.pricing_fields_immutable_after_create: All monetary fields and line fields MUST NOT change after snapshot creation (including totals and line components).
immutability.signature_stable: signature_hash MUST be computed at creation and MUST NOT change for the lifetime of the snapshot.

time_rules.activation_before_expiry: activated_at_utc MUST be <= expires_at_utc when status becomes active
time_rules.consumption_before_expiry: consumed_at_utc MUST be <= expires_at_utc when status becomes consumed

logs.label_posture: MUST NOT include org_id in labels; may appear in structured log body with access controls
logs.name: ticketing.pricing.signature_mismatch

experiment_constraints.non_overlapping_default: Default: at most one pricing experiment per surface per event. Multiple experiments allowed only when strictly non-overlapping (surface + audience) and super_admin-managed.
experiment_constraints.snapshot_traceability: If an experiment influenced pricing outputs, PricingSnapshot.pricing_experiment_id and pricing_variant_key MUST be set and immutable.
experiment_constraints.who_can_run: Only super_admin MAY start/stop pricing experiments; tenants MUST NOT have this capability.

pricing_engine.notes: Non-stacking rule: when subscriber pricing (entitlement context) is applied, the engine MUST set discount_stack_kind="none" and discount_total_minor=0 for that line.

phase_selection.determinism: If multiple phases match, select the phase with highest priority; ties break by phase_id lexical ascending.
phase_selection.matching: A phase matches when (starts_at_utc is null OR starts_at_utc <= quote_time_utc) AND (ends_at_utc is null OR quote_time_utc < ends_at_utc).
phase_selection.non_overlap_recommendation: To avoid ambiguity, implementations SHOULD prevent overlapping phases per revision unless priorities make outcomes deterministic.

program_selection.one_active_program_per_event: For a given {org_id,event_id}, there MUST be exactly one active PricingProgram and exactly one active PricingProgramRevision at any point in time.
program_selection.revision_selection: Quote creation MUST resolve the active PricingProgramRevision for {org_id,event_id} at quote_time_utc. The resolved revision_id MUST be stored in PricingSnapshot.pricing_program_revision_id.

rule_evaluation.base_price_requirement: For each purchasable line (ticket_type/addon/seat), a base_unit_price MUST be resolvable for the selected phase (either base_unit_price default or phase_override_unit_price for the chosen phase).
rule_evaluation.ordering: Enabled rules MUST be applied in descending priority, then rule_id lexical ascending.
rule_evaluation.orphan_discount: orphan_seat_discount rules MAY apply only when orphan_proof is provided and verified by the seating subsystem; absence MUST result in non-application (not error).
rule_evaluation.seat_proximity: seat_proximity_multiplier rules MAY apply only when seat_context.seat_proximity_rank is provided by SEAT subsystem; otherwise they MUST be treated as non-applicable.
rule_evaluation.tax_and_fee: Tax computation is governed by TAX-1 (future). tax_total_minor MUST be computed from a canonical tax context and MUST be included in signature inputs. For PRICE-SIG-V4, implementations MUST compute tax_context_digest_sha256 from the canonical tax context and include it in the signed snapshot.

attributes.notes: Tax pricing intent. inclusive = prices shown as tax-included; exclusive_add_on = taxes calculated and added as a separate line at cart/checkout time, but MUST still be computed for any consumable snapshot.

attributes.name: gross_subtotal_minor
attributes.notes: Gross subtotal (pre-discount): SUM(quantity*unit_price_minor) over PriceLine.

attributes.name: subtotal_minor
attributes.notes: Net subtotal (post-discount): gross_subtotal_minor - discount_total_minor (ND-184).

attributes.name: tax_total_minor
attributes.notes: Sum over lines: tax_total_minor

attributes.name: internal_rounding_adjustment_minor
attributes.notes: Semicent/rounding adjustment computed by PRICE-1 to satisfy exact arithmetic identity (ND-180/ND-184). May be negative, zero, or positive; platform-owned variance per ND-181.

attributes.name: discount_total_minor
attributes.notes: Total discounts applied (>= 0). Net subtotal is computed as gross_subtotal_minor - discount_total_minor.

attributes.name: grand_total_minor
attributes.notes: DEPRECATED name for total_minor. MUST equal total_minor.

attributes.name: total_minor
attributes.notes: Canonical total payable in minor units: subtotal_minor + fee_total_minor + tax_total_minor + internal_rounding_adjustment_minor (ND-184).

attributes.name: signature_hash
attributes.notes: SHA-256 hex lowercase digest over the exact UTF-8 byte stream that is signed for PRICE-SIG-V4 (RFC8785 JCS canonical JSON of pricing_signature_payload, including record_layout prefix rules). This MUST match recomputation per /signature_spec.

attributes.name: consumed_by_order_id
attributes.notes: Set exactly once when consumed; immutable thereafter

attributes.name: signature_version
attributes.notes: Signature scheme version tag. MUST equal PRICE-SIG-V4 for this contract version family.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.notes: Event scope for this quote/snapshot. MUST be authoritative for analytics and audit.

attributes.name: version
attributes.notes: Monotonically increasing version for this snapshot within (org_id,event_id). MUST be > 0. Derived atomically from PricingEventCursor.

attributes.name: occurrence_ids
attributes.notes: Occurrence scope for this quote/snapshot. MUST be non-empty; sorted unique; allows multi-occurrence orders.

attributes.notes: Immutable reference to the PricingProgramRevision that produced this snapshot.

attributes.name: pricing_phase_id
attributes.notes: Nullable. The phase selected at quote time (e.g., early_bird, phase_1).

attributes.name: pricing_experiment_id
attributes.notes: Nullable. Pricing experiment id when a pricing experiment influenced outputs.

attributes.name: pricing_variant_key
attributes.notes: Nullable. Stable variant label (e.g., A, B, control) used for analytics.

attributes.name: tax_context_digest_sha256
attributes.notes: sha256 digest of canonical tax context used to compute tax_total_minor values for this snapshot (PRICE-SIG-V4 binds this).

identities.name: pricing_event_version
identities.notes: Temporal fence: enforces unique, gap-detectable stream per event.

attributes.notes: Primary identifier

attributes.name: snapshot_id

attributes.notes: Domain reference identifier

attributes.name: tax_total_minor
attributes.notes: Tax amount for this line in minor units (>= 0). MUST include taxes for the base line item; fee taxes MAY be included here OR in FeeLine.tax_total_minor, but tax_total aggregation MUST be unambiguous.

attributes.name: fee_total_minor
attributes.notes: Fee amount for this line in minor units (>= 0). MUST equal SUM(FeeLine.amount_minor) where FeeLine.line_id == PriceLine.line_id.

attributes.name: discount_total_minor
attributes.notes: Discount amount for this line in minor units (>= 0)

attributes.name: line_total_minor
attributes.notes: Must equal (quantity*unit_price_minor) - discount_total_minor + fee_total_minor + tax_total_minor.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.notes: MUST equal PricingSnapshot.currency (no mixed-currency)

attributes.name: beneficiary_customer_id
attributes.notes: If subscriber pricing is applied for a beneficiary (buyer or a friend), this is the customer_id who owns the entitlement. Null when no entitlement-based pricing is used.

attributes.name: entitlement_grant_id
attributes.notes: Entitlement grant that justified subscriber/VIP pricing for this line. Null when no entitlement-based pricing is used.

attributes.name: entitlement_tier_id
attributes.notes: Entitlement tier associated with entitlement_grant_id at finalize time. Null when no entitlement-based pricing is used.

attributes.name: discount_stack_kind
attributes.notes: Deterministic indicator of discount stacking applied to this line. MUST be "none" for subscriber-priced (entitled) lines. For non-entitled lines, MAY be "none" or an implementation-defined token such as "promo_code" or "coupon".

attributes.name: fee_line_id
attributes.notes: Primary identifier

attributes.name: snapshot_id
attributes.notes: Foreign key to PricingSnapshot

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.notes: Foreign key to PriceLine (fee applies to this price line)

attributes.name: seq
attributes.notes: Deterministic ordering; unique per line_id; ascending

attributes.name: fee_code
attributes.notes: Stable fee identifier (e.g., service_fee, facility_fee, provider_gateway_fee).

attributes.name: amount_minor
attributes.notes: Fee amount in minor units (>= 0).

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.notes: Whether this fee is taxable (ND-185).

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.notes: Tax category (string/enum) used by TAX-1 (ND-185).

attributes.name: customer_visible
attributes.notes: Whether this fee is visible to customer (ND-187). Any customer-collected fee MUST be visible.

attributes.name: revenue_owner
attributes.notes: Who earns this fee (revenue attribution). Ownership MUST be explicit; no implied ownership by fee_code.

attributes.name: tax_total_minor

attributes.name: rounding_adjustment_minor
attributes.notes: Per-fee rounding adjustment (may be negative/positive) used only to satisfy arithmetic identity. MUST be posted to platform rounding_variance (ND-181).

rules.text: PRICE-1 MUST NOT depend on ORD-1 (avoid circular coupling).
PricingSnapshot MUST declare tax_pricing_mode and MUST bind tax_context_digest_sha256; exclusive_add_on mode requires sufficient tax jurisdiction context at quote time.

notes: PRICE-SIG-V4 binds entitlement context and tax context digest.
PRICE-SIG-V4 binds tax_pricing_mode to prevent display/checkout interpretation drift.
rules.text: Signature canonicalization MUST be fully specified and deterministic (PRICE-SIG-V4), while retaining verification support for PRICE-SIG-V1 and PRICE-SIG-V2 for historical snapshots.
Snapshot-level totals MUST be stored and MUST match line aggregates; totals are part of signature inputs.
Consumption is auditable: consumed_by_order_id is required on consume transition and is immutable.
All referenced subcodes MUST exist in ERR-1 registry; no contract-local subcodes without registration.
Ash 3.x operational surface MUST be explicit (domain, resources, actions, writable fields).
OBS-1 dependency MUST be satisfied by explicit required signals (pricing drift incidents must be observable).

PRICE-1 MUST represent fees as first-class FeeLine items carrying is_taxable, tax_category, customer_visible, and revenue_owner declarations (ND-185/ND-187/ND-188). No implicit fee defaults are permitted.

PricingSnapshot.version MUST be monotonic per (org_id,event_id) and MUST be assigned atomically using PricingEventCursor.current_version + 1 within the same DB transaction as snapshot + outbox insert. Version MUST be > 0. Gaps are corruption and MUST open a circuit breaker.

Producers MUST acquire a LOCKS-1 session/transaction-affine advisory lock using Namespace 102 on (org_id,event_id) before reading/updating PricingEventCursor. Lock key MUST be deterministic 64-bit (CRC64(org_id||event_id) or equivalent) to avoid collisions.
Deployments that tighten required_keys (e.g., adding version) MUST be executed under DMSC-1 drain+proof and MUST provide an automated backfill path for legacy snapshots.

canonical_encoding.description: Canonical JSON per RFC 8785 (JCS). Object keys are sorted lexicographically by Unicode code point; numbers are normalized per RFC 8785. UTF-8 encoding.

signature_spec.notes: PRICE-SIG-V4 signs a canonical JSON payload (RFC 8785) that binds quote TTL, tax context digest, fee ownership/taxability/visibility, and entitlement + discount stack context. This prevents substitution/replay across time, tax contexts, and discount entitlements.

EXT_IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY.notes: Idempotency key replay with mismatched inputs

PRICE_DISCOUNT_STACK_FORBIDDEN.notes: Subscriber-priced lines MUST NOT stack additional discounts. Raised when entitlement context is present and discount_stack_kind != "none" or discount_total_minor != 0.

PRICE_MIXED_CURRENCY.notes: Mixed currency detected between snapshot and lines

PRICE_SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED.notes: Snapshot expired or not active at verification time

PRICE_TOTAL_MISMATCH.notes: Snapshot totals mismatch against computed totals

TAX_JURISDICTION_REQUIRED.notes: Tax jurisdiction context required to compute taxes for exclusive_add_on mode.

summary:
Defines versioned pricing programs (phases, adjustments, experiments) and authoritative signed PricingSnapshots consumed by ORD-1; supports occurrence-aware quoting without breaking auditability.

Added explicit tax_pricing_mode (inclusive vs exclusive_add_on) and bound it in PRICE-SIG-V4 to prevent tax interpretation drift.
title: PRICE-1 — Pricing Programs, Versioned Rules & Snapshot Authority (Ticketing / Ash 3.x)
